{{Status infobox
|Physical Susceptibility

{{Icon|Physical Susceptibility icon|text=false|nolink=true}} [[Physical Susceptibility]] is a type of debuff inflicted to enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When enemies are inflicted with '''Physical Susceptibility''', temporarily take more {{Color|Physical DMG|1}}. The number represents the degree of increase.

Multiple sources of '''Physical Susceptibility''' stack <u>additively</u> to form the '''Susceptibility Multiplier''' for that DMG instance. The resulting Susceptibility Multiplier then stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
